_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'coldwater' (Coldwater Mere). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

mere_warden.name: Warden Oswy
mere_warden.greeting: Coldwater by name. Coldwater by nature. Coldwater down your boots.

elder_wenna.name: Elder Wenna
elder_wenna.greeting: Come in, warm up. Not too warm; the house is made of reeds.

netherby_fisher.name: Pike of Netherby
netherby_fisher.greeting: Netherby's the last village before the mere gets deep. And odd.

angler_coldwater.name: Marta Stillmere
angler_coldwater.greeting: Hear that bell? There is no bell. Lovely evening for it, though. See the ripples, just south-west of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

quests.name: Cold Slimes
quests.offer: Bog slimes in the peat cuttings. They slow the cutters and eat the lunches.

steps.text: Kill 6 bog slimes in the peat cuttings

quests.done: Lunch is safe. Peat is cut. Hooray for lunch.

quests.name: Serpent Season
quests.offer: Serpents in the reeds, serpents in the nets, serpents in my boot this morning. Thin them out.

quests.name: Tower Lights
quests.offer: Wisps keep pretending to be the tower lamp. Boats follow the wrong light into the mere.

steps.where: the mere shore below Mere Tower
steps.text: Kill 5 marsh wisps on the shore

quests.name: Frogs in the Well
quests.offer: The village well is full of croakers. The water tastes of frog. Don't ask how I know.

steps.text: Kill 6 fen croakers by the well

quests.done: Fresh water! Tastes of nothing! Wonderful!

quests.name: The Drowned Temple
quests.offer: There's a temple at the bottom of the mere. When the water's low you can walk in. Something there doesn't want visitors.

steps.text: Reach the lower halls of the Mere-Sunk Sanctum
steps.where: The Mere-Sunk Sanctum, the dungeon door in Coldwater Mere
the bottom of the Mere-Sunk Sanctum

quests.done: The temple's quiet. The mere seems warmer. Slightly.

quests.name: The Mere's Patient One
quests.offer: There's something in the deep mere that just waits. Waits for you to fall in. Go to it instead.

steps.where: roams the deep mere of Coldwater

quests.done: It's not waiting any more. Neither am I — drinks are on Netherby.
